eyebrow: Three fields packed into every float

steps.label: Exponent
steps.sub: how big or small the number can get

steps.label: Mantissa
steps.sub: how many significant digits you keep

code:
x = torch.tensor([3.14159265],
                  dtype=torch.float32)
print(x.element_size(), "bytes")
print(torch.finfo(torch.float32))

# 1 sign + 8 exponent + 23 mantissa bits
# range ~1e-38 to 3e38, ~7 decimal digits
caption: 8-bit exponent, 23-bit mantissa -- accurate enough you never think about it.

code:
big = torch.tensor([70000.0])

print(big.half())
# tensor([inf], dtype=torch.float16)
# max FP16 value is 65,504

print(big.bfloat16())
# tensor([70000.], dtype=torch.bfloat16)
# BF16 keeps FP32's 8-bit exponent range
caption: Same 16 bits, very different safety margin.
